review_notes: I read the whole file and checked its candidate definitions against Mathlib. The private realEquiv/ofRealHom, archMat, archUnit, adArrayL, integralSet and boxMeasure have no Mathlib counterpart. Mathlib has no continuity lemma for GeneralLinearGroup.map, and the file uses Continuous.units_map for that. The three raw-function matrix helpers (oneArray, elemArray, diagArray) re-spell Mathlib's Matrix.diagonal, 1 and Matrix.single. The file itself proves one equality with Matrix.diagonal. The project also has near-copies of realCoordinate and of oneEntries/elementaryEntries in other project files, but those are not Mathlib, so I did not report them. The finding is moderate: the helpers exist because archRealLift3 takes a raw function Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ, so some conversion is unavoidable. I did not check whether the corresponding Mathlib equation lemmas make the replacement shorter in practice.

findings.excerpt: private def diagArray (d : Fin 3 → ℝ) : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ := fun i j => if i = j then d i else 0
findings.problem: The file hand-rolls raw-function versions of Mathlib's diagonal, identity and elementary matrices. diagArray d is the function underlying Matrix.diagonal d. oneArray (line 205) is the function underlying (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ). elemArray (line 207) is the function underlying Matrix.single i j 1. The file proves of_diagArray, which says exactly this for diagArray, and later bridges back with Matrix.det_diagonal and Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal. It also needs a separate one_mem_invertibleSet proof and by_cases/simp arguments to unpack the ifs, instead of reusing Mathlib's Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply and Matrix.single_apply lemmas. These are three parallel local APIs for concepts Mathlib already names.
findings.proposed_change: Drop the three defs and pass coerced Mathlib matrices to archRealLift3, for example archRealLift3 ⇑(Matrix.diagonal d), archRealLift3 ⇑(1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) and archRealLift3 ⇑(Matrix.single i j (1 : ℝ)). Keep only a thin lemma about invertibleSet membership (det ≠ 0) stated in terms of Matrix.diagonal. Then of_diagArray, diagArray_one and oneArray_mem_invertibleSet go away, and the det and product lemmas become direct uses of Matrix.det_diagonal and Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal. If the raw-function form must stay, state it once as an abbreviation for ⇑(Matrix.diagonal d).
findings.benefit: Readers see standard matrix objects instead of three bespoke if-then-else functions. The conversion lemma and the bespoke simp/by_cases unpacking disappear. The file shares one convention with Mathlib's matrix API, and the same convention can be reused by the project's other copies of these helpers.
